title: Comparing photodegradation model systems: measuring bimolecular rate constants between photochemically produced reactive intermediates and organic contaminants
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, 27,2116-2127
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00199D, Paper
Luana de Brito Anton, Andrea I. Silverman, Jennifer N. Apell
Model systems are valuable tools for evaluating the indirect photodegradation of organic contaminants in aquatic environments and improve mechanistic understanding of these reactions to better predict environmental fate.
